definitions.gloss: to be conscious of; to be aware of
definitions.explanation: To deliberately pay attention to or be mindful of something. Used when someone becomes aware of or focuses on something they might otherwise overlook.

definitions.gloss: to be self-conscious about; to be attracted to
definitions.explanation: To become nervously aware of someone, typically due to romantic interest. Used when someone starts feeling awkward or attracted to another person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}して⟦{生活|せいかつ}する→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Live with awareness of your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}する⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた。
examples.english: More people are becoming conscious of environmental issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: I progressed with work efficiently while being mindful of the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}してしまう。

examples.japanese: ⟦{褒|ほ}められて→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}するようになった。
examples.english: After being complimented by her, I started to be aware of her in a romantic way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}するようになっていた。
examples.english: At first we were just friends, but before I knew it I had started to be conscious of him romantically.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is used broadly in daily life, business, and self-improvement contexts. Sense 2 is very common in romantic contexts and often appears in manga, dramas, and conversation among young people.
The noun ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ alone means "consciousness" or "awareness" and is also used in medical contexts (⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ = unconscious).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}する (be health-conscious)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}する (be mindful of time)
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{意識|いしき}する (become aware of someone romantically)
- {意識|いしき}し{始|はじ}める (start becoming conscious of)
- ⟦{無意識|むいしき}→無意識：05813_muishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (unconsciously — opposite)
